lines.en: I trot quickly across the ford.
My frill parts a clump of grass.
Four small legs move busily.
I keep low, which makes me look smaller.
I follow behind my herd.
I run a few paces, then stop to look.
I squeeze past the left side of the boulder.
The grass is taller than me, and I push through.
I trot off looking for shoots.
My prints come in strings.
I hear a noise and run two steps.

lines.zh: 我的小尾巴帮我保持平衡
lines.en: My little tail keeps me level.

lines.zh: 我在平原上散开成一群
lines.en: We spread across the plains as a herd.

lines.zh: 我朝同伴叫了一声，跟上
lines.en: I call to the herd to keep up.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方草还没直起来
lines.en: The grass has not straightened where I stepped.

lines.zh: 跑起来我的冠饰一晃一晃
lines.en: My frill bobs as I run.
I walk close along a herdmate's flank.

lines.zh: 我们一群挪过整片草原
lines.en: The herd drifts across the whole meadow.
I stand and swing my head around.
I am listening to the grass.
The sun warms my frill.
I peck at the dirt.
My herdmate is a few steps away.
I lift a leg, then set it down.

lines.zh: 风把我的小冠吹得发凉
lines.en: The wind cools my small frill.

lines.zh: 我盯着一个会动的东西
lines.en: I fix on something that moves.
I lower myself to the ground.
I wait for the herd to move first.
I turn my face to the sun.
My tail brushes off a bug.

lines.zh: 这里没有肉食者的味道
lines.en: No predator smell here.
I chew a grass stem.
I glance at the distance.
I tilt my head, judging distance.
I have to crane my neck to look up at you.
I shrink my neck and edge away.
If you bend down, I run.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛离不开你的鞋。
lines.en: My eyes won't leave your boots.

lines.zh: 你是食草的还是食肉的
lines.en: Are you a grazer or a hunter?
My whole herd is watching you.
Is the thing in your hand edible?
I raise my frill toward you.
I do not start trouble.
You are in my path.

lines.zh: 我小跑两步，又停下看你
lines.en: I trot two steps, then stop and look.

lines.zh: 我的同伴已经躲到后面了
lines.en: My herd has slipped behind me.
I squeal, high and sharp.
My frill is knocked askew.
I shrink into the grass.
That landed on my back.
My two front legs give way.
I run, but not far.
I shake myself off.
Blood is on my frill.
I call for the herd to go.
I can still stand up.
Those shoots look good.
I think I smell something sweet.
Put it down and I will come.
I trot over.
I cannot reach your hand.
I will finish that in one mouthful.
I do not dare get too close.
I take a bite, then back away.
Kneel down and I will stop being afraid.
My herdmates want some too.
This beats dry grass.
I stretch my neck for it.
I chew while watching you.
A little more and I will follow you.
I peck up every crumb.
I look up, still hungry.
You nearly stepped on me.
That bump spins me on the spot.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你看不见我吗
lines.en: I am small, but not invisible.
I ran into your leg.
I skip aside, then look back.
A herdmate jostled me.
I'm squeezed until all four feet slip.
The herd bumps into a tangle.
My frill touched you.
It is fine, I am tough.
We nuzzle heads.
She runs, and I run after.

lines.zh: 我们在草丛里并排蹲下
lines.en: We crouch side by side in the grass.
These shoots are ours.
I circle her once.
Our calls are soft.
The eggs will go in sun-warmed sand.
The herd will keep watch together.
She goes first, I take the rear.
Our heads rest together.
A dropped shoot is mine.
I pick it up in my beak.
So small, not enough to share.
I try, but cannot swallow it.
It rolled into the grass and I lost it.
I sniff it before eating.
A herdmate wants it, so I run with it.
I hold it under a claw.
This is a bit hard.
Whoever dropped it, thanks.
You've come within reach of my horn.
I fix on you and hold still.
My herd has scattered.
I raise my frill so you see it.
I am small, but I have a frill.
You are standing on my grass.
My growl is thin.
One more step and I butt.
I stand in front of my herd.
My horn is aimed at your knee.
I circle you in small loops.
I wait for you to stoop.
My frill stays pointed at you.
I neither retreat nor charge.
I squint and count your steps.
My herd is behind me.
I keep my eyes fixed on your lowered hand.
Reach out and I butt.
I press myself even lower.
I pant hard, but I do not flee.
I lower my head and butt.
My frill hits your shin.
Not heavy, but sudden.
I hit and dart away.
I nip your trouser leg.
You retreat, so I stop.
My head dips and rises.

lines.zh: 这一撞用了我全身的力
lines.en: That took all my strength.
My frill is not useless.
There, do not come back.
I poke out of the grass.
The plains have gained a small herd.
I raise my head to read the ground.
Tender grass and soft wind here.
I came along my herdmates' tracks.
My frill comes out first.
I trot to find my place.
I remember the wind of Mongolia.
No big ones here, good.
I settle into the grass.
I sniff, and it is safe here.
I am here, and the grass stirs.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，烫得我直跳
lines.en: Fire scorches my back and I leap.
I tumble off the rock.

lines.zh: 水没到我的冠，我拼命挣
lines.en: Water covers my frill and I struggle.
The blast bowls me over.
An arrow grazes my leg.

lines.zh: 魔法打在我身上，毛都竖了
lines.en: Magic hits and my hide prickles.
The grass is dry and I cry with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我吓得乱撞
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and I bolt blindly.
The ground suddenly is not there.
